<thought>Based on the observed isotopic pattern—regular ~1 Da spacing with rapidly decreasing intensities (M = 100, M+1 ≈ 8 %, M+2 ≈ 0.5 %, etc.)—the pattern matches the natural carbon isotopic distribution (12C/13C). No other element shows this characteristic pattern at these intensities, so carbon can be definitively identified.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
